title: TraceableAI: an open-source agentic framework for PRISMA-compliant literature synthesis
description: TraceableAI runs a systematic literature review following PRISMA 2020 with a language model and records every step: the protocol written before the search, the raw responses of the bibliographic sources, every screening decision with its rationale, the extraction and quality appraisal with verified quotes, a citation support check and a SHA-256 manifest of all files. This record is the software release archived by Zenodo; each GitHub release gets its own DOI.

creators.name: Lau, Philip S. P. Ø. O.
